scope: Author-side static validation of the exact M1674 source package. No runner, Formality, PrimeTime, DC, VCS, PTPX, GPU or remote attempt was executed.

future_execution_plan.step_1: M1675 different-author source hammer and negative mutation review.
future_execution_plan.step_2: M1676 exact-SHA one-attempt release after all other EDA is idle.
future_execution_plan.step_3: One fm_shell process proves frozen RTL to original admitted M993 using the original M993 SVF.
future_execution_plan.step_4: A second fm_shell process proves original M993 mapped gates to M1665 mapped gates without an SVF assumption.
future_execution_plan.step_5: One independent pt_shell process reads only exact M1665 mapped Verilog and SDC and reports slow-max/fast-min timing with both SRAM views.
future_execution_plan.step_6: A different author hammers the sealed result before any claim.

author_findings.incremental_svf_handling: The M1665 SVF is identity evidence only. Transitive equivalence uses RTL-to-M993 with the original M993 SVF followed by M993-to-M1665 gate equivalence.
author_findings.constraint_integrity: PrimeTime consumes the exact M1665 SDC at 3.000 ns with setup/hold uncertainties 0.200/0.050 ns and adds no exceptions.
author_findings.macro_integrity: Both Formality and PrimeTime load the checksum-pinned SRAM library; PrimeTime requires exactly nine TS1N28HPCPHVTB128X128M4S instances.
author_findings.physical_boundary: The planned PT result remains prelayout, no-SPEF, ideal-clock and ZeroWireload; it is not post-route signoff.
